test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the odd group of numbers. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13–Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)
solution:
The pattern followed is:

First \: number over10 = Second number 

Second \: number over10 = Third number

Let us check each option:

1. (400 – 40 – 4) 

The pattern followed here is:

⇒400over10 = 40 

⇒ 40over 10 = 4 

Then, it will be (400 – 40 – 4).

2. (300 – 30 – 7) 

The pattern followed here is: 

⇒300over10 = 30 

⇒30 - 23 = 7 

Then, it will be (300 – 30 – 7). 

3. (1000 – 100 – 10) 

The pattern followed here is:

⇒ 1000over10 = 100 

⇒100over10 = 10 

Then, it will be (1000 – 100 – 10) 

4. (500 – 50 – 5) 

The pattern followed here is: 

⇒500over 10 = 50 

⇒50 over 10 = 5 

Then, it will be (500 – 50 – 5).

**The pattern followed is:**

First \: number over10 = Second number 

Second \: number over10 = Third number

Option 1, Option 3 and Option 4 have the same pattern only Option 2 has a different one then, and the odd one out is Option 2.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'.**
